Home / Coatings
Coatings

Coating systems.

Seven systems, from PE for interiors to PVDF and PUPA for coastal and high-flex use. Each system sets durability, weatherability and formability.

Systems

Choose by exposure.

Coastal & harsh

PVDF

Fluoropolymer for coastal and harsh exposure. Holds gloss and colour through salt, UV and industrial pollution.

High-flex forming

PUPA

Bends into tight profiles after coating. Common for rolling shutters.

Inland & moderate

HDPE

High-durability polyester for general construction.

Interior & mild

PE

Cost-effective polyester with a wide colour range for signage and interiors.

Protective

Epoxy-PE

Epoxy-polyester for protective, general-purpose use.

Finish-driven

Acrylic

Acrylic-based system for specific finishes and appearance.

Flexible

PU

Polyurethane system for flexibility and surface performance.

Specialty

Functional coatings.

Easy-clean

Surfaces that resist dirt and simplify cleaning.

Antibacterial

Surface treatment for hygiene-sensitive environments.

Anti-graffiti
